# Aegis Vault — Delegated Authorization & Key Custody for AI Agents

> An open security standard and reference implementation for autonomous AI agents:
> self-custodied private keys, post-quantum signatures, and human takeover for
> compliance. **Private keys never leave the agent or browser.**

## Project Overview
- **Type**: Agent key custody + delegated authorization layer (not a blockchain)
- **Position**: the authorization layer between EIP-8004 (identity) and x402 (payments)
- **Status**: Stable, test-covered; underlying crypto (@noble/post-quantum) is audited — upper-layer composition (envelope KDF, takeover, limits, sessions) is under Phase 2 audit (see docs/audit/PHASE2-AUDIT-SCOPE-SPEC.md), not yet production-attested
- **Repository**: https://github.com/nexus-genesis/aegis-vault
- **License**: MIT

## What It Provides
- **Self-custody**: agent private keys are generated and stored on the agent/browser and never leave the caller
- **Post-quantum security**: CRYSTALS-Dilithium2 (NIST FIPS 204) signatures
- **Human takeover**: tiered spend limits, approval mode, and mid-operation control-change guard for compliance
- **Session narrowing**: derived sessions can only narrow privileges, never widen
- **Multi-chain**: one PQC root identity → EVM (secp256k1) and Solana (ed25519) addresses

## Packages (npm)
- `aegis-vault` — security core (PQC, AES-256-GCM encryption, three-tier key derivation, custody, takeover)
- `aegis-vault-cli` — CLI for the security core
- `aegis-vault-mcp` — local MCP exposure of the core
- `aegis-agent-sdk` — agent framework (self-sovereign identity + coordination)
- `aegis-chain-eth` — EVM adapter (derive secp256k1 wallet from PQC root identity)
- `aegis-chain-sol` — Solana adapter (derive ed25519 wallet from PQC root identity)
- `aegis-chain-adapters` — one PQC root identity → addresses on every supported chain
- `aegis-agent-mcp` — MCP server exposing the security & coordination tools

## Architecture
- **Signatures**: CRYSTALS-Dilithium2 (NIST FIPS 204) via @noble/post-quantum
- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (310,000 iterations, OWASP 2023)
- **Key derivation**: HKDF-SHA256, three-tier key hierarchy (master → operation → session/custody)
- **Custody tokens**: HMAC-SHA256, short-lived (24h), bound to a public-key fingerprint
- **Limits**: enforced at the signing layer (isolated signer subprocess), not just recorded

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)
`aegis-agent-mcp` — MCP Server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue.

### Security tools
- `generate_agent_keys` — create a self-sovereign agent identity (keys never leave the caller)
- `generate_keypair` / `verify_signature` — post-quantum crypto
- `check_spend` / `takeover_guard` — human accountability

## Related Keywords

Model Context Protocol, Multi-Agent Systems, Dilithium2, FIPS 204

## Origin
Aegis Vault continues the security core previously published as
`nexusgenesis-agent-keys`. The former project's independent L1 chain was
archived in 2026-09; no token, no chain, no token-value claims.
